Surface Properties

Tip

  1. Need help? Please let us know in the SUEWS Community.

  2. Please report issues with the manual on GitHub Issues (or use Report Issue for This Page for page-specific feedback).

  3. Please cite SUEWS with proper information from our Zenodo page.

4.4.50. Surface Properties#

Base properties for all surface types

Note

Example values below are parameter choices compiled in the SUEWS parameter database, which is being prepared for publication. Until its release, the cited studies provide the supporting evidence. These values are not defaults or recommendations; select or calibrate values for the site.

sfr#

Surface fraction of grid area covered by this surface type

Unit:

dimensionless

Default:

0.14285714285714285

emis#

Surface emissivity for longwave radiation

Unit:

dimensionless

Default:

0.95

ohm_threshold_summer_winter#

Summer/winter threshold based on temperature for OHM calculation

Unit:

degC

Legacy name:

ohm_threshsw

Default:

0.0

ohm_threshold_wet_dry#

Soil moisture threshold determining whether wet/dry OHM coefficients are applied

Unit:

dimensionless

Legacy name:

ohm_threshwd

Default:

0.0

ohm_coef#

The ohm_coef parameter group is defined by the Seasonal/Wetness OHM Coefficients structure.

soil_depth#

Depth of soil layer below surface for hydrological calculations, controlling sub-surface water storage and drainage processes. Site-specific value typically determined from soil surveys or borehole data

Unit:

mm

Legacy name:

soildepth

Configuration Note:

No default value. A value may be required depending on which physics options and surface types are active in your configuration.

Example values

Value

Context

Source

1000 mm

Beijing; subsurface soil; Below mixed vegetation

Zheng et al. [2023]

349 mm

Helsinki; subsurface soil; Below Grass

Havu et al. [2024]

1000 mm

Havu et al. [2024]

1000 mm

Helsinki; subsurface soil; Mixed Park trees

Havu et al. [2024]

349 mm

Zurich; subsurface soil; Trees

Stagakis et al. [2025]

349 mm

Zurich; subsurface soil; Below Grass

Stagakis et al. [2025]

350 mm

SE England; subsurface soil; Below all surfaces (generic)

Ward et al. [2016]
soil_store_capacity#

Maximum water storage capacity of soil layer, representing total water holding capacity between field capacity and wilting point. Site-specific value dependent on soil texture, structure, and depth

Unit:

mm

Legacy name:

soilstorecap

Configuration Note:

No default value. A value may be required depending on which physics options and surface types are active in your configuration.

Example values

state_limit#

Upper limit to the surface water state

Unit:

mm

Legacy name:

statelimit

Default:

10.0

wet_threshold#

Surface water-depth threshold above which the surface is treated as fully wet and surface resistance becomes zero

Unit:

mm

Legacy name:

wetthresh

Default:

0.5

saturated_hydraulic_conductivity#

Saturated hydraulic conductivity of soil layer, controlling water drainage rate through fully saturated soil. Site-specific value determined from soil texture (higher for sandy, lower for clay); typically measured via laboratory or field infiltration tests

Unit:

mm s-1

Legacy name:

sathydraulicconduct

Configuration Note:

No default value. A value may be required depending on which physics options and surface types are active in your configuration.

waterdist#

Water distribution parameters

The waterdist parameter group is defined by the Water Distribution structure.

storage_drain_params#

Storage and drain parameters

Legacy name:

storedrainprm

The storage_drain_params parameter group is defined by the Drainage Parameters structure.

snowpack_limit#

Limit of snow that can be held on surface

Unit:

mm

Legacy name:

snowpacklimit

Default:

10.0

thermal_layers#

Five material layers for the surface, ordered from the exposed surface inward

The thermal_layers parameter group is defined by the Material Layers structure.

irrigation_fraction#

Fraction of surface area that can be irrigated

Unit:

dimensionless

Legacy name:

irrfrac

Default:

0.0

ref#

The ref parameter group is defined by the Reference Info structure.
